comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. The width knob is 0 to 1 used as 300 raised to that power in milliseconds and the decay knob as 30 raised to that power times ten milliseconds, both defaulting to 0.5, which is about 17ms and about 55ms. The decay time is turned into the two resistor values of the modelled circuit against a fixed 0.015 microfarad capacitor. The double tap knob is -1 to 1 and is used as minus twice its value, applied only where the shaped envelope is below zero, so at its centre the tail is removed entirely. None of the three CV inputs is clamped, so a large voltage can push a parameter far past what the knob can reach.
